fn descriptor_bytes(plugin_id: &str, package_id: &str, version: &str, component_sha256: &str, schema: Option<&str>, dependency: Option<(&str, &str)>) -> Vec<u8> {
    let artifact_kinds = schema.map_or_else(Vec::new, |schema| {

/// `artifact_creation_selection` is the same unambiguity rule scoped to one kind: exactly one
/// writable editor target whose codec identity this generation verified.
new:
/// `artifact_creation_selection` is the creation rule scoped to one kind: the owners' ONE most
/// general writable editor target whose codec identity this generation verified.

{
  "why": "The one most-general-dialect rule over the surfaces of ONE role that share a document: a whole-standard dialect `<kind>@<standard>/*` covers every subset dialect `<kind>@<standard>/<subset>` of its own kind and standard (every document of a subset of a standard is a document of the whole standard), and nothing else covers anything. The answer is the ONE candidate no other candidate covers; several uncovered candidates (whole-standard dialects of two standards, subsets without their whole standard, one dialect twice) are ambiguous and refused rather than resolved by order; no candidate answers none. Readers: the guest's `artifact_codec_owner` (which app of a bundle answers `codec.*` for a document schema, per role), the hub's creation selection (which editor creates a kind, within the deciding owner-or-host tier) and the hub's default document-open surface (which surface of a role opens a document when the client names none). `candidates` are canonical dialect coordinates (`ArtifactDialect::to_coordinate`); `mostGeneral` is the index of the answer, `ambiguous` or `none`.",
  "liveDefects": [
    "Ticket 26/09/23 LB2 T7d p17, proof p17-s1 on 2026-09-29: the guest refused `codec.*` for the 13 document schemas that subset surfaces share with their whole-standard surface (stdio json, xml; image jpg, svg, tiff; cad dwg, step; bim ifc 2x3; pdf 1.7; office docx, pptx, xlsx; binary zip) with `artifact codec schema resolves more than one app of the same role`, so no host could create or register them.",
    "Ticket 26/09/23 H14 on 2026-09-29: the hub's creation selection required exactly one editor per kind, so every multi-subset kind (json and xml owned by stdio; jpg, svg, tiff, step, docx, pptx, xlsx, zip, ifc and the semio kinds hosted by the stdio families) was never offered for creation, and a document opened without a requested surface (the semio MCP workspace) resolved no surface."
  ],
  "cases": [
    { "name": "the whole standard covers its subset (stdio json)", "candidates": ["s.stdio.json@rfc8259/*", "s.stdio.json@rfc8259/i-json"], "mostGeneral": 0 },
    { "name": "order never decides: the whole standard listed last (stdio xml)", "candidates": ["s.stdio.xml@1.0/valid", "s.stdio.xml@1.0/*"], "mostGeneral": 1 },
    { "name": "the whole standard covers every subset of its standard (step ap214)", "candidates": ["s.stdio.step@ap214/cc1", "s.stdio.step@ap214/cc2", "s.stdio.step@ap214/*", "s.stdio.step@ap214/cc3", "s.stdio.step@ap214/cc4", "s.stdio.step@ap214/cc5", "s.stdio.step@ap214/cc6"], "mostGeneral": 2 },
    { "name": "office strict and transitional under ecma-376", "candidates": ["s.stdio.docx@ecma-376/strict", "s.stdio.docx@ecma-376/transitional", "s.stdio.docx@ecma-376/*"], "mostGeneral": 2 },
    { "name": "one whole standard alone", "candidates": ["s.stdio.png@1.2/*"], "mostGeneral": 0 },
    { "name": "one subset alone is the most general there is", "candidates": ["s.stdio.zip@2.0/iso21320"], "mostGeneral": 0 },
    { "name": "two standards' whole-standard dialects (dwg ac1018, ac1024)", "candidates": ["s.stdio.dwg@ac1018/*", "s.stdio.dwg@ac1024/*"], "mostGeneral": "ambiguous" },
    { "name": "two standards each with subsets (pdf 1.4, 1.7)", "candidates": ["s.stdio.pdf@1.4/a", "s.stdio.pdf@1.4/*", "s.stdio.pdf@1.7/*", "s.stdio.pdf@1.7/ua"], "mostGeneral": "ambiguous" },
    { "name": "a whole standard covers only its own standard's subsets (ifc 4 vs 2x3)", "candidates": ["s.stdio.ifc@4/*", "s.stdio.ifc@2x3/cobie"], "mostGeneral": "ambiguous" },
    { "name": "subsets without their whole standard", "candidates": ["s.stdio.jpg@jfif-1.01/baseline", "s.stdio.jpg@jfif-1.01/progressive"], "mostGeneral": "ambiguous" },
    { "name": "one dialect twice (two surfaces or two packages)", "candidates": ["s.fixture.document@1/*", "s.fixture.document@1/*"], "mostGeneral": "ambiguous" },
    { "name": "a whole standard never covers another kind's subset", "candidates": ["s.stdio.gif@87a/*", "s.stdio.png@87a/strict"], "mostGeneral": "ambiguous" },
    { "name": "no candidate", "candidates": [], "mostGeneral": "none" }
  ]
}
